en.name: Miraculous Communion of Blessed Imelda Lambertini
en.summary: A radiant Host is said to have risen and come to rest before an eleven-year-old girl too young to receive Communion.
en.body: Blessed Imelda Lambertini, an eleven-year-old novice in Bologna considered too young to receive her First Communion, was reported to see a Host rise from the altar in a burst of light and come to rest before her; she died shortly after receiving it.
